name: Praveg Ltd
tagline: Asset-heavy tent-resort operator on mostly government land that has slid into losses, trades at ~100x+ earnings with no hospitality track record, and carries a stack of governance flags - repeated dilution, an asset-life accounting change and KMP/auditor exits
business_overview: Praveg runs premium tented resorts (Rann of Kutch, Lakshadweep, Daman, and now pilots in Kenya/Tanzania) plus a legacy outdoor-advertising and public-toilet PPP business. ~75% of its ~14 resorts sit on leased government land (short leases, high annual royalty). 'Vision 2028' targets 65 resorts / 2,500 rooms, increasingly via an 'investor-capex' asset-light pivot after years of in-house capex.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 241 Cr revenue; PAT ~ -Rs 10 Cr TTM (was +Rs 16 Cr FY25)
5-yr revenue CAGR ~40% off a tiny base; growth guidance repeatedly missed
Near debt-free - yet promoters keep diluting via warrants/preferential
fundamentals_narrative: A 20-year-old company that has still not crossed ~Rs 250 Cr revenue, and has now tipped into losses (TTM PAT negative, ROE -2.4%). Operating leverage is structurally poor: most sites have fewer than 50 tents but carry a full kitchen/reception/admin cost base, and fixed headcount jumped from ~100 to ~1,500 in two years. Even after an ~75% price crash the stock trades at ~100-111x earnings versus Indian Hotels at ~60x, on a business with no moat and promoters with no prior hospitality experience. Multiple forum analysts flag a change in depreciation policy (extended asset lives) that inflates PAT, 6-7 rounds of warrant/preferential dilution in 2023-24 despite being debt-free, a promoter-entity merger that pushed promoter holding above 50%, a string of KMP and internal-auditor resignations in 2023, and an ex-MD's Rs 100 Cr defamation suit against the promoter. An Income-Tax search was stated by management to have concluded with no findings.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. Down ~75% from the 2024 peak near Rs 1,200 to ~Rs 300; forum technicians see little structural support and further downside risk.
sentiment_summary: Large 179-post thread that has turned decisively skeptical since the 2024 crash. Recurring bear points (runitkapoor, Tontichor_Akhilesh, Shreni_Makharia, Cshar, CA_Sonali): flawed low-operating-leverage model, extreme valuation vs Indian Hotels, no moat / no hospitality pedigree, depreciation-policy change to boost PAT, serial dilution, promoter-stake engineering, KMP/auditor churn, and a promoter (Vishnukumar Vithaldas Patel) with an alleged buy-low/sell-high pattern across other listed entities. Bulls (astha.arora23, Kailasa_Tiwari) point to hard-to-get premium locations, an IHCL association at Bangaram, the light-capex ad/toilet business and an asset-light pivot, with 'FY28 could be a breakout year' - but that is the same forward narrative that has been missed for three years.
community_signal: The dominant high-engagement posts are risk flags, not conviction calls: several independent posters converged on the accounting-policy change, serial dilution and promoter-conduct concerns as reasons to avoid despite the price fall.
bse_notes: No active SEBI order found. Concerns raised in-thread: change in depreciation accounting (asset lives extended) that raises reported PAT; repeated warrant/preferential issues (6-7 in 2023-24) despite a debt-free balance sheet; merger of a promoter-linked entity lifting promoter holding above 50%; multiple KMP and internal-auditor resignations in 2023; an ex-MD Rs 100 Cr defamation suit against the promoter; an Income-Tax search that management says closed without findings.
bull_case: Access to genuinely scarce premium eco-tourism locations (Rann of Kutch, Lakshadweep, island/forest sites) that competitors struggle to secure
IHCL association at Bangaram and an asset-light 'investor-capex' pivot could reduce the balance-sheet burden of expansion
Low-capex, policy-backed outdoor-advertising and public-toilet PPP verticals provide an optional second leg
Indian domestic-tourism tailwind is real and multi-year
bear_case: Structurally poor operating leverage - sub-50-tent sites with a full fixed-cost base; fixed headcount up 100 -> 1,500 in two years
Now loss-making (TTM PAT negative, ROE -2.4%, ROCE 1.5%) yet still ~100x+ earnings, well above Indian Hotels
Governance stack: depreciation-policy change that inflates PAT, 6-7 dilution rounds despite no debt, promoter-stake engineering, 2023 KMP/auditor exits, ex-MD defamation suit
~75% of resorts on short government land leases with high royalty - thin, non-owned asset base and renewal risk
Three straight years of missed guidance; 'FY28 breakout' is an unfalsifiable forward story
thesis_fit: neither - a loss-making, low-operating-leverage, richly-valued business with a heavy governance overhang; no credible path to a 10x or 100x on current evidence
verdict_headline: Governance-dominated: serial dilution, a PAT-flattering accounting change and promoter-conduct concerns on top of a loss-making, over-priced model - avoid
verdict_reasoning: First-time coverage. Both the trailing record (20 years, still sub-Rs 250 Cr revenue) and the recent trend (slipped into losses, ROE -2.4%) are weak, with no offsetting catalyst that is not already three years overdue.

The forum independently and repeatedly flags a depreciation-policy change that inflates PAT, 6-7 rounds of dilution despite zero debt, promoter-stake engineering via an entity merger, and 2023 KMP/auditor resignations - collectively a HIGH CAUTION governance profile even though there is no active SEBI action or formal promoter-holding collapse.
Valuation (~100-111x earnings on a loss-making TTM) offers no margin of safety; forum technicians see further downside.
thesis_fit neither; conviction Low. Not flagged for 30-day revisit (thesis_fit neither). Recheck only if audited accounts normalise the depreciation treatment and losses reverse.
red_flag_reason: Multiple converging governance flags: a change in depreciation accounting (extended asset lives) that inflates reported PAT, 6-7 rounds of warrant/preferential dilution in 2023-24 despite a debt-free balance sheet, a promoter-entity merger that pushed promoter holding above 50%, a string of KMP and internal-auditor resignations in 2023, and an ex-MD's Rs 100 Cr defamation suit against the promoter. No active SEBI order, so not EXCLUDE; no single promoter-holding collapse, but the cluster warrants HIGH CAUTION.
